decisions.reason: As a young product closely aligned with the firm's industrial heat-exchanger capabilities, its performance is still too uncertain to justify withdrawal and a medium-sized established firm is likely to use some slack to continue learning.

A web-based weir-dimensioning tool looks more peripheral to a machinery maker's core business, so if it falls short of aspirations it is a stronger candidate for reallocation, but after only one year the firm would still likely give it some time.

A fouling detection system for heat exchangers appears strongly related to the firm's core engineering market, so absent clear evidence of underperformance management would likely retain it while assessing customer uptake.
